title: feat: playback trace line and display rate match

commit.merge_subject: merge: feat: playback trace line and display rate match

description: P3. (1) PlaybackTrace (pure, injected clock): one ritim-trace line per playback run with picked / shown / late / dropped and the published-frame gap p50/p95 against the frame period, written when the loop ends (debug builds). (2) DisplayRate: the refresh-rate pick (exact multiple, else most even) ported from Klipp with JVM tests; while a clip plays the preview Surface asks for its rate (Surface.setFrameRate fixed-source, seamless-only on API 31+), with the window preferredDisplayModeId (same-resolution modes only) as the fallback when there is no Surface or the API is older; released on pause/stop/leave. NOTICE records the port (plan K6). ClockSmoother is not ported: it only follows if the measurement shows audio-clock jumps.
